title: Show Origin On Compose Diagram
description: ComposeDiagram SVG: show u=0,v=0 origin marker (crosshair), behind edges/nodes, pointer-events none; optional prop to hide; extend vitest in compose/ui index.
summary: ComposeDiagram: crosshair at diagram origin (u=0,v=0) using same toPixel* as nodes; muted-foreground strokes, pointer-events none, drawn under edges/nodes. New prop showOrigin (default true). Helper resolveComposeDiagramOriginPixels + vitest. Files: compose/ui/index.tsx only.
